jsonLd.name: How Your Accountant Match Works
jsonLd.description: A free 3-step matching process that connects you with one vetted local accountant partner based on your postcode and accounting needs.

step.name: Tell us what you need
step.text: Share your postcode or area and the accounting help you're looking for — whether that's a personal tax return, business accounting, bookkeeping and BAS, SMSF services, or a new business registration. It takes about 60 seconds and there's no obligation.

step.name: We match you by area
step.text: Your postcode determines your match. Each area is covered by one participating, vetted accountant partner who owns that territory. The services you select are passed along as enquiry details — they never change which accountant you're matched with.

step.name: Your matched accountant contacts you
step.text: Your enquiry is sent directly and exclusively to the accountant partner who covers your area. They receive your contact details, location and the services you selected, then reach out to discuss your needs, fees and engagement terms directly with you.

blocks.heading: How It Works
blocks.text: THE PROCESSHow It WorksOur quick 60-second, 3-step matching process is designed to be fast, specific and local, so you reach the right firm without sifting through generic directories. Here's exactly what happens from the moment you start to the moment your matched accountant gets in touch.1Tell us what you needShare your postcode or area and the accounting help you're looking for — whether that's a personal tax return, business accounting, bookkeeping and BAS, SMSF services, or a new business registration. It takes about 60 seconds and there's no obligation.2We match you by areaYour postcode determines your match. Each area is covered by one participating, vetted accountant partner who owns that territory. The services you select are passed along as enquiry details — they never change which accountant you're matched with.3Your matched accountant contacts youYour enquiry is sent directly and exclusively to the accountant partner who covers your area. They receive your contact details, location and the services you selected, then reach out to discuss your needs, fees and engagement terms directly with you.One match, by postcodeYour Accountant Match is a free matching and referral service. We match you with one participating accountant from our vetted partner network based on your postcode. The matched accounting firm provides all accounting and taxation services directly. Your enquiry is never sent to multiple providers, and the services you select are passed to your matched accountant as enquiry information only — they do not change which accountant covers your area.Find My Accountant
